name: Signal
title: Signal: a number of Rouh's own, you write to it and Rouh answers there

permissions: reads the messages to Rouh's own Signal number through the owner's signal-cli-rest-api, every few seconds; a message from anybody but the owner or a trusted contact the owner linked to a number is dropped
sends the answer to the owner's own message back to their number
registers Rouh's number with Signal from its page, on the owner's press, with the code Signal sends
jobs: the Signal reader (rouh/signal_chat.py Listener), started with Rouh
touches.remove: rouh/signal_chat.py, the signal service in rouh/service_keys.py, its section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, the two signal routes in rouh/web/chat_apps.py and this manifest.
